name: @baize/app
description: baize-godot 编辑器 Electron 应用（渲染进程 React UI + 主进程 godot-process）

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite" "tsdown -c tsdown.config.main.ts --watch" "tsdown -c tsdown.config.preload.ts --watch" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 dist-electron/main.js dist-electron/preload.cjs && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron ."
scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist-electron',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsdown -c tsdown.config.main.ts && tsdown -c tsdown.config.preload.ts && vite build
